meta.title: Classic+ rebuilt vanilla trees
meta.schema: matches trees.json: rows with points gate and talents with ranks and text
meta.accuracy: Twenty-three trees parsed from prose; seven match their stated point totals exactly and the rest are within five. Four trees described only in prose (Mage Fire, Rogue Subtlety, Warlock Destruction, Warrior Protection) were written out by hand. Treat point totals as approximate and talent text as abbreviated. Category membership, which is what this dataset exists to answer, is reliable.
meta.knownLimitation: Keyword matching on talent text cannot answer whether a tag conversion would light a talent up. Marksmanship scores 94% for ranged keywords and every match is about Auto Shot timing or Aimed Shot specifically, none of which a converted trap would touch. The measurement is over-inclusive here where the vanilla version was under-inclusive. Answering that question needs an explicit reads field, authored rather than inferred.
meta.readsField: Authored. A talent reads a category only if its effect would automatically extend to a NEW member of that category, which is the only thing a tag conversion can exploit. 'Your Fire spells cannot be pushed back' reads fire; 'Fireball applies a burn stack' reads nothing, because it names one spell. Talents whose rebuild text was 'kept' or 'unchanged' were backfilled from vanilla descriptions.

talents.text: Kept from vanilla. After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell, gives you a N% chance to gain Mana equal to the base cost of the spell.

talents.name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by N%.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

talents.name: Judgement of Light
talents.text: replacing Lasting Judgement: your Judgement heals whoever strikes the target, then scales with your healing bonus, then cannot be overwritten.

talents.name: Righteous Shield
talents.text: sideways: your Blessing of Sanctuary scales with your healing bonus, Holy Shield may be maintained while healing.

talents.name: Devotion
talents.text: subtraction: your heals cost no mana while above 50% health; below 50% you cannot heal at all.

talents.name: Holy Power
talents.text: reworked from critical chance to critical heal behavior.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 204 to 220 Holy damage to an enemy, or 204 to 220 healing to an ally.

talents.name: Righteous Defense
talents.text: Damage you take generates threat on its source; then on everything within 8 yards; then blocked damage generates double; then threat you generate does not decay while you hold aggro; then a target that switches off you takes holy damage. -

talents.name: Redoubt
talents.text: Blocking refreshes your Seal; consecutive blocks raise your block value for 6 seconds; a block below 30% health grants a charge of Holy Shield; blocking a critical strike stuns nothing but refunds mana; blocks generate threat on the whole encounter.

talents.name: Guardian's Favor
talents.text: Blessing of Protection's cooldown drops; it may be cast on yourself while silenced. -

talents.name: Anvil
talents.text: Consecration generates threat on targets that resist it; it follows you for 3 seconds; it refreshes when you block; it applies your Judgement debuff; it cannot be outranged by a target inside its original radius. -

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
talents.text: Righteous Fury also converts healing received into threat; it persists through death; it applies to your Consecration.

talents.name: Blessing of Kings
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Places a Blessing on a friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

talents.name: Reckoning
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a critical strike.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.text: Your shield's absorb applies to your party's next hit; absorbed damage generates threat; your block value scales with your Blessing of Sanctuary. -

talents.name: Bulwark
talents.text: Shield Block covers an extra attack; it may be used while stunned; it refreshes on a parry.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
talents.text: Cooldown drops; it may be cast at range; per Section 5.8 it also reduces a stun-immune target's damage by 10% for its duration. -

talents.name: Aura Mastery
talents.text: Your aura applies to the whole raid rather than your party; you may run two auras at once; switching auras costs no global cooldown.

talents.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage dealt from all sources by up to 10 for 5 min. In addition, when the target blocks a melee attack the attacker will take 14 Holy damage. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one t

talents.name: Hand of Light
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Holy Light and Flash of Light generate no threat on a target you are tanking; healing yourself refreshes Righteous Fury; your heals scale with your block value. Every paladin heals, so it stands alone, worth most to a Holy main at 26/25. -

talents.name: Crusader's Resolve
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Seal damage generates threat as though doubled; Seal of Command may proc from a block; your Judgement applies to everything striking you. -

talents.name: Immovable
talents.text: Subtraction node. You cannot be moved, feared, stunned, or knocked back. Your movement speed is reduced by 30% at all times.

talents.name: Ardent Defender
talents.text: Below 35% health, damage taken is reduced; then a killing blow is survived once every 3 minutes; then survival grants a full Holy Shield; then it heals you for the overkill; then it resets Lay on Hands. One-Handed Weapon Specialization deleted outright.

talents.name: Holy Shield
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 65 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

talents.name: Sanctified Blessings
talents.text: Greater Blessings last twice as long; they may be cast on any raid member rather than only your party; recasting one does not clear it from others; they persist through the target's death; one cast applies to an entire party. -

talents.name: Crusader's Word
talents.text: Blessing of Might also grants you its attack power; Blessing of Wisdom returns mana on your critical strikes; Blessing of Freedom may be cast on yourself while stunned; Blessing of Sacrifice transfers threat as well as damage; a blessing you cast refreshes your current Seal.

talents.name: Seal Mastery
talents.text: Your Seal persists through weapon swaps; judging does not consume it; a Seal refreshes when you Judge; two Seals may be active at once; your Seal applies to your first attack after leaving combat. -

talents.name: Improved Judgement
talents.text: Judgement's cooldown drops; it may be cast while moving; it applies your Seal to a second nearby target. -

talents.name: Vindication
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives the Paladin's damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Strength and Agility by N% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Seal of Command
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives the Paladin a chance to deal Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 90 to 95 Holy damage, 137 to 1

talents.name: Righteous Fury
talents.text: Consecration ticks faster on targets you have Judged; Holy damage you deal refreshes Judgement; your Judgement debuff cannot be overwritten by another paladin; Judging a target already Judged by you extends both; Consecration follows you for its first 3 seconds. -

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases movement and mounted movement speed by N%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. All spell criticals against you cause N% of the damage taken to the caster as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.name: Vengeance
talents.text: Rewritten from a flat damage bonus to a chain: a critical strike opens a window; inside it your next Judgement is free; then Consecration does not consume mana; then the window extends on each crit; then it may be opened by your Seal's proc rather than only by your own crit. -

talents.name: Zeal

talents.name: Hammer of Wrath
talents.text: Moved into the tree as a genuine button rather than a trainer skill. -

talents.name: Sanctified Light
talents.text: Sideways node. Holy Light and Flash of Light may be cast while your Seal is active without breaking it; your heals extend your Judgement; healing a target below 30% refreshes your Seal. Every paladin heals, so it stands alone, and it is worth most to a Holy main at 26/25. -

talents.name: Bulwark of Faith
talents.text: Sideways node. Blessing of Sanctuary's block damage scales with your attack power; Holy Shield may be maintained while a two-handed weapon is equipped; damage you block refreshes your Seal. -

talents.name: Zealotry
talents.text: Subtraction node. Your Seals never expire and cannot be dispelled. You may no longer benefit from any blessing cast by another paladin. Sanctity Aura moves to the depth dividend at 20 points, on the same reasoning as Trueshot Aura and Leader of the Pack. Improved Enslave-style fi

talents.name: Crusade
talents.text: Your Judgement applies to everything your Consecration touches; then Seal of Command chains to a second target; then Judging refreshes every blessing you have cast on your party; then your Seal procs cannot be resisted; then a Judgement that kills its target has no cooldown.

talents.name: Repentance
talents.text: Kept, with the graded fallback from Section 5.8: against a target immune to incapacitation it instead removes all of the target's beneficial magic effects. ### 11.3 After 52 points against vanilla's 45. Sixteen nodes against fifteen. Forced flat to the capstone: zero, against 24

talents.name: Silent Resolve
talents.text: Reworked from a threat percentage: your first heal on a target generates no threat; then overhealing generates none; then healing a target below 30% generates none; then threat you would generate transfers to the tank; then your shields generate none. -

talents.name: Inner Focus
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
talents.text: The shield does not break on your own damage; it may be cast on a target already shielded, refreshing rather than failing; its expiry heals for what it did not absorb; a shield that absorbs its full value refunds its mana. Wand Specialization and Unbreakable Will are both deleted

talents.name: Meditation
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Allows N% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Martyrdom

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
talents.text: Fortitude applies to the raid rather than the party; it persists through death. -

talents.name: Absolution
talents.text: Dispel Magic removes one additional effect; it may be cast while casting; dispelling grants the target a shield; dispelling an enemy buff damages them; failed dispels refund mana.

talents.name: Focused Will
talents.text: Casting is not interrupted by damage below a threshold; then pushback is capped at once per cast; then a completed heal under fire grants Focused Casting; then interruption instead extends your next cast's power; then you may cast while silenced once every 45 seconds. -

talents.name: Reflective Shield
talents.text: Power Word: Shield returns a portion of absorbed damage; the return scales with your spell damage; it applies to everything attacking the shielded target.

talents.name: Mental Agility
talents.text: Reworked: instant spells do not trigger the global cooldown when cast on a target below 20%; then Renew may be applied to two targets; then Shield and Renew share a cast; then instants refresh Inner Fire; then your next instant after a Greater Heal is free. -

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
talents.text: Inner Fire is not consumed by damage; it grants spell damage as well as armor. -

talents.name: Mana Burn
talents.text: Reworked and given a Section 5.8 fallback: against a target with no mana it instead deals shadow damage equal to what it would have burned.

talents.name: Divine Spirit
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 30 min.

talents.name: Grace
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Renew and Prayer of Healing benefit from your shield's absorb value; healing a shielded target extends the shield. Every priest has both, so it stands alone, worth most to a Holy main at 26/25. -

talents.name: Shadow Affinity
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Shadow Word: Pain refreshes when you shield its target; Mind Blast generates no threat while a shield of yours is active; your shields benefit from your shadow damage. -

talents.name: Ascetic
talents.text: Subtraction node. Your healing is increased substantially. You may no longer cast Power Word: Shield. *Ascetic is the Section 5.4 example rewritten. The original draft named it Vow of Silence and gave it a mana clause; this version trades the class's signature spell for throughpu

talents.name: Power of the Word
talents.text: Your shields chain to a second target; then Power Infusion's cooldown drops; then shields cannot be dispelled; then a shield that expires unspent grants a charge; then a full charge makes your next Greater Heal instant.

talents.name: Power Infusion
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing by 20%. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Healing Focus
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

talents.name: Renewal
talents.text: Renew ticks once immediately; a target at full health banks the tick; Renew's remaining duration is added when refreshed; Renew on a target below 30% heals double and ends; Renew spreads to a nearby ally when its target dies. -

talents.name: Holy Concentration
talents.text: Your critical heals refund mana; then reduce your next heal's cast time; then grant the target 10% of the overheal as a shield.

talents.name: Attunement
talents.text: Reworked from Divine Fury: **your talents scale with what a heal does, not with which heal it is.** Any heal cast on a target below 50% is faster; then any heal that lands on a target at full health becomes a shield; then any overheal is banked toward your next cast; then any hea

talents.name: Spell Warding
talents.text: Reworked to discrete schools, and per Section 5.8 it also reduces physical damage taken while a heal of yours is active on you.

talents.name: Holy Nova
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 29 to 34 Holy damageto all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 54 to 63. These effects cause no threat.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, heal N% of the damage taken over 6 sec.

talents.name: Inspiration
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increase your target's armor by N% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from your Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, or Prayer of Healing spell.

talents.name: Circle of Healing
talents.text: Added as a genuine button, the thing this tree never had. -

talents.name: Improved Healing
talents.text: Reworked from mana cost: your area heals prioritise the lowest-health target; then they cannot overheal; then they refund mana per target already at full health. -

talents.name: Holy Reach
talents.text: Reworked: your heals reach further; then your area heals apply to anyone within your Holy Nova radius; then range no longer reduces their effect.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 10 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the pri

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases spell damage and healing by up to N% of your total Spirit.

talents.text: Sideways node. Your heals on a shielded target extend the shield; a shield that breaks while you are casting refunds its mana; Power Word: Shield benefits from your healing bonus. Every priest shields, so it stands alone, worth most to a Discipline main at 26/25. -

talents.name: Martyr
talents.text: Subtraction node. Your healing is increased while you are below 50% health. You may no longer heal yourself.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
talents.text: Reworked from a healing percentage: your heals on a target you have healed in the last 6 seconds chain to a second ally; then the chain carries Renew; then it cannot overheal; then it prefers a target with no heal-over-time active; then a full chain refunds a portion of the cast.

talents.name: Guardian Spirit
talents.text: Replaces Lightwell. Place a spirit on an ally that heals them, and once, prevents a killing blow. A capstone should not depend on other players clicking something. 52 points against 48. Forced flat zero against 20 of 30. ---

talents.name: Spirit Tap
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience. For the duration, your Mana will regenerate at a 50% rate while casting. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Blackout
talents.text: both kept, Blackout given a graded fallback per Section 5.8.

talents.name: Shadow Affinity
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by N%.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
talents.text: reworked from resistance to what an unresisted spell does.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
talents.text: reworked to refresh behavior.

talents.name: Mind Flay
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 75 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast
talents.text: reworked from cooldown: Mind Blast refreshes Shadow Word: Pain, then generates no threat, then applies Shadow Weaving at full stacks, then its cooldown resets on a killing blow, then it consumes Shadow Word: Pain for burst.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
talents.text: kept with a fallback.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your Shadow damage spells have a N% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Shadow damage. This vulnerability increases the Shadow damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Mind Melt
talents.text: your periodic shadow damage refreshes on Mind Flay, then Mind Flay may be cast while moving, then it does not break on damage, then it applies Vampiric Embrace's healing, then a full channel resets Mind Blast.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 1 min.

talents.name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the percentage healed by Vampiric Embrace by an additional N%.

talents.name: Silence
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec.

talents.name: Inner Light
talents.text: sideways: your Renew benefits from your shadow damage, your heals extend Vampiric Embrace, Power Word: Shield does not break Shadowform.

talents.name: Void
talents.text: subtraction: your shadow damage is greatly increased and you may not be healed by anyone but yourself.

talents.name: Darkness
talents.text: reworked from spell damage to Shadowform behavior.

talents.name: Shadowform
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15% and reducing Physical damage done to you by 15%. However, you may not cast Holy spells while in this form.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. After killing a target that yields experience or honor, gives you a N% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Improved Eviscerate
talents.text: reworked to combo point behavior.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.text: your first strike from stealth grants a combo point, then Cheap Shot and Garrote share a cooldown reduction, then stealth breaks slower, then Vanish resets Cold Blood, then a stealth opener cannot miss.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives your finishing moves a N% chance to add a combo point to your target.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.text: reworked to refresh behavior.

talents.name: Find Weakness
talents.text: your finishers reduce armor.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
talents.text: critical strikes with a finisher apply a bleed that scales with combo points spent.

talents.name: Envenom
talents.text: and

talents.name: Toxicology
talents.text: poisons stack higher, apply from finishers, cannot be cleansed, benefit from your critical chance, and a fully stacked poison may be consumed for burst.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, or Eviscerate by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. While affected by your Kidney Shot ability, the target receives an additional N% damage from all sources.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
talents.text: sideways: your stealth abilities cost less while Slice and Dice is active, Premeditation feeds Seal Fate.

talents.name: Blood Price
talents.text: subtraction: your finishers deal substantially more damage and cost health as well as energy.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your critical strikes from abilities that add combo points have a N% chance to add an additional combo point.

talents.name: Master Poisoner
talents.text: replacing Vigor.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by N sec.

talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike
talents.text: reworked to combo point behavior.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.text: Sinister Strike may be used from any angle, then it refreshes Slice and Dice, then a critical grants a combo point, then two in a row make the next free, then it applies your poison.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Bladework
talents.text: parrying grants a combo point, then dodging does too, then avoidance refreshes Riposte, then a parry refunds energy, then Riposte cannot be avoided.

talents.name: Improved Backstab
talents.text: reworked to positional behavior.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by N.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.text: kept with a graded fallback per Section 5.8.

talents.name: Adrenaline
talents.text: energy regeneration increases below 20 energy, then a finisher refunds energy, then Evasion grants energy, then energy caps higher during Blade Flurry, then abilities cost no energy for 3 seconds after a killing blow, then Sprint costs energy rather than a cooldown.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: the fork: swords proc an extra attack, maces stun, fists reduce the target's attack speed, daggers gain a positional-free Backstab.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives your Kick ability a N% chance to silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Vitality
talents.text: your poisons persist through weapon swaps, then apply from Blade Flurry, then a poison application refreshes Slice and Dice, then two poisons may be on one weapon, then poisons benefit from your critical strike chance.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases your attack speed by 20%. In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Killing Spree
talents.text: sideways: your Backstab and Ambush benefit from your off-hand, Cheap Shot's stun applies your Expose Armor.

talents.name: Cutthroat
talents.text: sideways: your poisons benefit from Lethality, Envenom-style finishers consume poison stacks for damage.

talents.name: Duellist
talents.text: subtraction: you deal substantially more damage from the front and none at all from behind.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.text: reworked from a damage percentage to finisher behavior.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.text: Stealth is harder to detect; then it does not break on ambient damage; then it may be entered in combat once per minute.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.text: Openers from stealth generate an extra combo point; then they cannot be dodged; then they apply Expose Armor.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.text: Openers grant an additional combo point; the effect works on a raid pull rather than only from stealth.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.text: Stealth movement speed rises; then Vanish resets it; then Sprint does not break stealth.

talents.name: Improved Sap
talents.text: Sap lasts longer; against sap-immune targets it instead reduces damage dealt.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. A strike that deals 125% weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.text: Finishers reduce armor; then apply a bleed; then the bleed scales with combo points spent.

talents.name: Setup
talents.text: Avoiding an attack grants a combo point; then Riposte does; then a full dodge chain refreshes Evasion.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.text: Vanish and Blind cooldowns drop; Vanish removes damage over time effects.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.text: A strike that marks the target so your party's physical damage is increased; it stacks; it persists through your death; it transfers on target death.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Deadened Nerves
talents.text: Cross-tree. Your poisons benefit from your stealth openers; Ambush and Backstab apply your active poison at double stacks.

talents.name: Silent Death
talents.text: Subtraction. Your openers cannot be dodged or resisted and generate no threat. You deal no damage from the front. The deliberate mirror of Combat's Duellist.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.text: Grants combo points before an opener; then they persist through a target change; then they cannot be lost; then Premeditation resets on a killing blow; then it grants an extra finisher point.

talents.name: Shadowstrike
talents.text: A strike from stealth that does not break stealth, usable once per Vanish.

talents.name: Convection
talents.text: Reworked: a Shock refunds mana on a critical strike; then Lightning Bolt refunds on overload; then your totems draw from your mana pool rather than costing up front; then a spell cast at full mana costs nothing; then Clearcasting also refunds the previous spell. -

talents.name: Storm Reach
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by N yards.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the damage taken by Fire, Frost and Nature effects by N%.

talents.name: Call of Flame
talents.text: Reworked: Fire totems inherit your spell critical chance; Fire Nova arms instantly when an enemy enters its radius; Magma Totem pulses on a target that flees. -

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
talents.text: Stoneclaw taunts on a delay rather than instantly; Earthbind slows casting as well as movement. -

talents.name: Static Field
talents.text: Your Lightning Shield orbs are shared with your totems; totems struck discharge an orb; a discharged orb refreshes Flame Shock.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Reverberation
talents.text: Reworked: Shocks no longer share a cooldown with each other; then a Shock refreshes on a critical strike; then Earth Shock interrupts through immunity; then Frost Shock's slow applies to attack speed; then a Shock cast during Clearcasting costs nothing and does not consume the pr

talents.name: Storm Caller
talents.text: Lightning Bolt may be cast while moving at reduced damage; then Chain Lightning cannot be resisted on its first target; then a critical Lightning Bolt shortens Chain Lightning's cooldown; then overloads cannot draw threat; then Chain Lightning bounces back to its origin.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your offensive spell crits will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by N% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage.

talents.name: Improved Fire Totems
talents.text: Fire Nova's delay is removed entirely; a Fire totem that dies detonates.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the critical strike challenge bonus of your Searing, Magma, and Fire Nova totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

talents.name: Stormstrike Affinity
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Flame and Frost Shock scale with your attack power as well as your spell damage; your weapon imbue adds to your spell damage; melee critical strikes grant Clearcasting. Every shaman imbues a weapon, so it stands alone, worth most to an Enhancement main at 26/2

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
talents.text: Sideways node. Your Chain Lightning's jump logic applies to Chain Heal; healing a target grants them your next Lightning Shield discharge; Clearcasting applies to your heals. -

talents.name: Grounded
talents.text: Subtraction node. Your spells cannot be resisted or interrupted. You may no longer critically strike with them. Vanilla's three-point tier becomes eight, matching the Feral fix.

talents.name: Lightning Mastery
talents.text: Reworked from cast time to behavior: Lightning Bolt gains a chance to overload and cast a free second copy; then overloads can chain; then they apply Flame Shock; then Chain Lightning can overload; then an overload refunds the original spell's mana.

talents.name: Elemental Mastery
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, this spell gives your next Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell a 100% critical strike chance and reduces the mana cost by 100%.

talents.name: Stormbringer
talents.text: Windfury can proc from an extra attack once per swing; its proc rate stops scaling down with weapon speed; a proc refreshes your weapon imbue duration; two procs in a row make your next Shock free; a proc grants a stack that increases the next one's damage. -

talents.name: Totemic Focus
talents.text: Dropping a totem no longer resets your swing timer; totems inherit your weapon imbue's element; a totem destroyed by an enemy refunds its mana; you may drop two totems on one global cooldown; **your buff totems follow you within 20 yards.**

talents.name: Elemental Cadence
talents.text: Earth Shock leaves the Flame and Frost Shock cooldown alone; a Shock within 3 seconds of a Windfury proc costs no mana; Frost Shock also slows attack speed; Flame Shock spreads to a second target on your next proc; Shocks no longer clip your swing. -

talents.name: Charged
talents.text: Lightning Shield orbs are consumed by your attacks as well as by being hit; losing an orb refunds mana; at full orbs your next Shock chains to a second target. -

talents.name: Guardian Totems
talents.text: Stoneskin also shortens movement-impairing effects; Windwall reflects one ranged attack every 10 seconds. -

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
talents.text: Ghost Wolf becomes instant; then usable in combat.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Effect determined by equipped weapon, the same fork pattern used in Arms and in Bladedancer. Two-handed axes and maces make critical strikes bleed; one hand and shield makes a block generate a Lightning Shield orb; fist and dagger raises Windfury's proc rate. -

talents.name: Enhancing Totems
talents.text: Strength of Earth and Grace of Air persist for 10 seconds after leaving their radius; they scale with your weapon imbue; recasting one does not clear its buff from anyone still in range.

talents.name: Static Charge
talents.text: Critical strikes add an orb to Lightning Shield; orbs beyond maximum become damage; crits refresh your weapon imbue; at full orbs a crit discharges one at a nearby enemy; a crit within 3 seconds of a Windfury proc grants another proc. -

talents.name: Ancestral Guidance
talents.text: Healing Wave no longer stops your swing; Lesser Healing Wave may be cast while moving; healing a target grants them your Lightning Shield's next discharge; your heals generate no threat while a totem of yours is active; overhealing becomes attack power for 6 seconds.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
talents.text: Sideways node. Your weapon imbues also add spell damage; Flame and Frost Shock scale with it; your Lightning Bolt may be cast while your swing timer is running. Worth its points to any shaman who imbues a weapon, which is all of them, and worth most to an Elemental main at 26/25.

talents.name: Improved Weapon Totems
talents.text: Windfury Totem also grants its attack power to you while you are within range of it; its proc can trigger from an extra attack; Flametongue Totem applies your weapon imbue to the party; a totem you drop refreshes the imbue on everyone in range. -

talents.name: Earthbound
talents.text: Subtraction node. Your totems become immune to damage and last twice as long. You may have only one totem active at a time.

talents.name: Windfury Mastery
talents.text: Windfury's extra attacks use your main hand's full damage; they can critically strike; they generate no threat; they refresh Flame Shock; a proc during Stormstrike's window adds a third attack.

talents.name: Stormstrike
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you an extra attack. In addition, the next 2 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
talents.text: reworked: a heal that overheals refunds mana, then chains to a second target, then banks toward your next cast.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing
talents.text: your heal grants armor, then damage reduction, then it applies to everyone the heal touched, then it persists 10 seconds after the heal, then it cannot be dispelled.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation
talents.text: kept.

talents.name: Chain Mastery
talents.text: Chain Heal jumps further, then prefers the lowest-health target, then does not lose effect per jump against targets below 30%, then can bounce back to its origin, then jumps to a target with no heal-over-time first.

talents.name: Healing Focus
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

talents.name: Totemic Mastery
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

talents.name: Totemic Reach
talents.text: totems affect the raid rather than the party, then follow you within 20 yards, then persist 10 seconds after being destroyed.

talents.name: Healing Grace
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by N%.

talents.name: Restorative Totems
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the effect of your Mana Spring and Healing Stream totems by N%.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
talents.text: reworked from critical chance to what a critical heal does.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Healing Way
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your Healing Wave spells have N% chance to increase the effect of subsequent Healing Wave spells on that target by 6% for 15 sec. This effect will stack up to 3 times.

talents.name: Elemental Communion
talents.text: sideways: your Lightning Shield discharges heal instead of damage while a healing totem is active, your Chain Lightning uses Chain Heal's jump logic.

talents.name: Ancestor's Vigil
talents.text: subtraction: your totems heal continuously and cannot be destroyed; you may not cast direct heals.

talents.name: Purification
talents.text: reworked from healing percentage to dispel and cleanse behavior.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 170 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 20 yards.

talents.name: Suppression
talents.text: reworked: your damage-over-time effects cannot be dispelled at rank 3, and cannot be resisted on application at rank 5.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
talents.text: reworked from cast time: Corruption applies instantly at rank 1, then refreshes on your Shadow Bolt, then ticks faster below 20%, then spreads on death, then carries remaining damage forward when refreshed.

talents.name: Improved Drain Soul
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to get a 100% increase to your Mana regeneration for 10 sec if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul. In addition your Mana may continue to regenerate while casting at 50% of normal.

talents.name: Siphon
talents.text: merging the drain talents: Drain Life and Drain Mana channel while you move, then do not break on damage, then benefit from your shadow damage, then apply Corruption, then refund a shard on a killing blow.

talents.name: Curse Mastery
talents.text: two curses may be active at once, then curses cannot be dispelled, then a curse refreshes on your damage-over-time ticks, then Amplify Curse has no cooldown, then curses apply to everything Corruption is on.

talents.name: Fel Concentration
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling the Drain Life, Drain Mana, or Drain Soul spell.

talents.name: Amplify Curse
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Curse of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Grim Reach
talents.text: kept and extended to all Affliction effects.

talents.name: Nightfall
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives your Corruption and Drain Life spells a N% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Drain Mana
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Causes 15% of the Mana drained by your Drain Mana spell to damage the opponent.

talents.name: Shadow Embrace
talents.text: your damage-over-time effects reduce healing received, and a target with three of them takes increased shadow damage.

talents.name: Siphon Life
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Transfers 15 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Soul Siphon
talents.text: sideways: your Shadow Bolt refreshes Corruption, your Immolate benefits from your shadow damage, Conflagrate does not consume Immolate on a target affected by Corruption.

talents.name: Malediction
talents.text: sideways: your curses benefit from your fire damage and Curse of Shadow applies to your pet's attacks.

talents.name: Unstable Affliction
talents.text: subtraction: your damage-over-time effects deal substantially more damage and detonate when dispelled; you may no longer cast Shadow Bolt.

talents.name: Shadow Mastery
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by N%.

talents.name: Dark Pact
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Drains 150 of your pet's Mana, returning 100% to you.

talents.name: Bound Servant
talents.text: Your demon inherits your resistances; then your armor; then it survives your death; then it returns at 30% health thirty seconds after dying; then summoning costs no shard. -

talents.name: Familiar
talents.text: Your Imp's Firebolt applies Corruption; your Voidwalker's Torment scales with your shadow damage; your Succubus's Seduction breaks only on damage you deal. -

talents.name: Soulcraft
talents.text: Healthstones can be used while silenced; creating one below 30% health costs no shard.

talents.name: Soul Tether
talents.text: Health Funnel channels while you cast; your demon's damage returns health to you; a demon at full health funnels back to you instead; Health Funnel on a full demon becomes damage against its target; your demon's regeneration applies to you while it is idle. -

talents.name: Demonic Resilience
talents.text: Your demon takes reduced damage from area effects; it cannot be feared; when it attacks, it breaks roots on you. -

talents.name: Guardian
talents.text: Voidwalker's Sacrifice absorbs based on your health rather than the Voidwalker's; Consuming Shadows can be cast on you.

talents.name: Fel Domination
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its mana cost reduced by 50%.

talents.name: Swift Binding
talents.text: Fel Domination's cooldown drops; then it applies to Enslave Demon; then a demon summoned under it arrives at full health; then swapping demons carries your active buffs across; then Fel Domination holds two charges. -

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.text: Succubus's Lash of Pain reduces healing received; Felhunter's Spell Lock silences longer against a target mid-cast; Imp's Fire Shield reflects to a second attacker.

talents.name: Master Summoner
talents.text: Summoning is instant if your previous demon died within 10 seconds; summoning does not break your current cast. -

talents.name: Demonic Empowerment
talents.text: Each demon gains a command you can trigger. The Imp becomes a charge you detonate; the Voidwalker taunts everything near it; the Succubus vanishes and re-engages behind its target; the Felhunter devours one beneficial effect. The fifth rank takes the command off the global cooldo

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
talents.text:
Kept from vanilla. When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect that lasts 30 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

Succubus: Increa

talents.name: Shadow Bond
talents.text: Sideways node. Your demon's damage benefits from your curses; your Corruption refreshes on any target your demon damages; your demon's critical strikes extend Siphon Life. Every warlock has Corruption, so it is worth its points alone, and worth most to an Affliction main at 26/25

talents.name: Ashen Pact
talents.text: Sideways node. Your demon's attacks apply your Immolate's fire damage; Conflagrate does not consume Immolate while your demon is on the target; Searing Pain from you draws no threat if your demon is attacking. -

talents.name: Unbound
talents.text: Subtraction node. **You may have two demons active at once. Neither may be sacrificed, and both take double damage.**

talents.name: Master Demonologist
talents.text: Kept and rewritten from stat auras to behavior. Imp: your Destruction spells cost no shard to empower. Voidwalker: threat you generate transfers to it on a delay. Succubus: your first spell on a fresh target cannot be resisted. Felhunter: your curses cannot be dispelled. Fifth ra

talents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
talents.text: Shadow Bolt applies a vulnerability consumed by the next attacker; then it stacks; then it does not expire; then it applies on cast rather than on hit; then it spreads on death.

talents.name: Aftermath
talents.text: Destruction spells daze; then slow casting; then apply Immolate's burn at reduced value.

talents.name: Improved Immolate
talents.text: Immolate's direct half scales with its remaining periodic damage; then it refreshes on Shadow Bolt; then it cannot be dispelled; then it ticks faster below 20% health; then it detonates on expiry.

talents.name: Intensity
talents.text: Destruction spells cannot be pushed back.

talents.name: Destructive Reach
talents.text: Range increases; threat is reduced; Rain of Fire follows a marked target.

talents.name: Shadowburn
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Instantly blasts the target for 91 to 104 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

talents.name: Improved Searing Pain
talents.text: Searing Pain draws no threat; then it consumes Immolate for burst; then it applies Immolate; then it refreshes Conflagrate; then two casts in a row are free.

talents.name: Pyroclasm
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, and Soul Fire spells a N% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Devastation
talents.text: Reworked from critical chance into what a Destruction critical does: it refreshes Immolate, then applies Aftermath, then grants a shard.

talents.name: Emberstorm
talents.text: Fire spells consume Immolate stacks for damage; then Rain of Fire applies Immolate; then Hellfire does not damage you while Immolate is active.

talents.name: Ruin
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

talents.name: Cataclysm
talents.text: Cross-tree. Your Immolate counts as a curse; Corruption refreshes it; Curse of Agony benefits from your fire damage.

talents.name: Nether Protection
talents.text: Cross-tree. Your demon's attacks apply Immolate; Soul Link shares your fire damage bonus.

talents.name: Backdraft
talents.text: Subtraction. Conflagrate loses its cooldown. You may no longer cast Shadow Bolt.

talents.name: Conflagrate
talents.text: Conflagrate no longer consumes Immolate; then it extends it; then it hits a second target; then it cannot be resisted; then it resets on a killing blow.

talents.name: Shadow and Flame
talents.text: Your Shadow Bolt and Immolate each empower the other, so alternating them is stronger than repeating either.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: Rend ignores armor; Overpower refreshes it; below 20% health it dumps its remaining damage at once. -

talents.name: Poise
talents.text: Dodged and parried attacks refund their Rage; Overpower's cooldown resets on a dodge; you cannot be disarmed in Battle Stance; Hamstring's slow cannot be dispelled; Rage does not decay while a target you struck recently is still alive. Deflection is gone. Its parry now arrives th

talents.name: Concussion
talents.text: Thunder Clap also slows casting; it spreads Rend to targets already bleeding; it becomes usable in any stance. -

talents.name: Headlong
talents.text: Charge usable in combat when no enemy is within 8 yards; Charge interrupts spellcasting. -

talents.name: Tactical Mastery
talents.text: Retain all Rage swapping to Battle Stance, then Berserker, then Defensive; then no stance swap cooldown; then swapping stances reopens Overpower's window. Tactical Mastery survives almost intact because it was already behavioral. Only its ranks change from numeric to discrete.

talents.name: Rupture Line
talents.text: Execute refreshes your bleeds; bleeds on a target below 20% tick twice as fast; a target dying while bleeding refunds the Rage spent on Execute. -

talents.name: Mortal Cleave
talents.text: The sideways node from 5.3. -

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.text: The subtraction node from 5.4. -

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.text: Being stunned or rooted generates Rage; the second rank breaks the effect once per 30 seconds.

talents.name: Riposte Reading
talents.text: Overpower cannot be dodged or parried; Overpower's window opens on any miss rather than only a dodge. -

talents.name: Deep Wounds
talents.text: Critical strikes cause bleeding; refreshing carries remaining damage forward rather than overwriting; the bleed jumps to a nearby enemy on death. -

talents.name: Battle Trance
talents.text: Three consecutive attacks without a miss makes your next Overpower or Execute free.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Effect determined by equipped weapon rather than by node, using the same weapon fork pattern as the Bladedancer tree in Class Absorption. Axes bleed on crit, swords proc an extra attack, maces stun, polearms strike a second target behind the first. -

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.text: Sweeping Strikes copies Overpower; its extra hits can trigger Deep Wounds. This is the row that fixes vanilla's 18-point weapon specialization block. Four nodes and 20 points collapse into one node and 5, and the choice moves from the talent panel to the weapon in your hand.

talents.name: Crippling Grip
talents.text: Hamstring may root; the root is not broken by your own bleed damage; Hamstring is free against a bleeding target. -

talents.name: Death Sentence
talents.text: Execute refunds its Rage on a kill; usable below 35% against targets you have Rent; a kill by Execute resets Overpower. -

talents.name: Unyielding
talents.text: Reduced duration on stuns; then on disarms; then you continue attacking for 2 seconds after a fear begins.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Booming Voice
talents.text: reworked: shouts affect the raid, then persist through death, then refresh on a killing blow, then cost no rage below 20 rage, then apply to targets rather than allies as a debuff.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: critical strikes cause bleeding, then the bleed feeds rage, then it does not stack but carries forward, then it spreads on death, then it doubles below 20%.

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Gives you a N% chance to generate an additional Rage point when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

talents.name: Improved Demoralizing Shout
talents.text: reworked to a debuff behavior chain.

talents.name: Blood Craze
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Regenerates N% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike.

talents.name: Piercing Howl
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Causes all enemies near the warrior to be dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Cleave
talents.text: reworked: Cleave hits a third target, then applies your last special attack's effect, then costs no rage while enraged.

talents.name: Rampage
talents.text: a killing blow grants attack speed, then it stacks, then it persists 10 seconds out of combat, then it triggers on a critical strike, then it carries across targets.

talents.name: Enrage
talents.text: reworked from damage percentage to what being enraged enables.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.text: becomes the weapon fork used in Arms, Enhancement, and Bladedancer.

talents.name: Improved Execute
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by N.

talents.name: Death Wish
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, increases your physical damage by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but lowers your armor and all resistances by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Intercept
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept abiilty by N sec.

talents.name: Sundering Blows
talents.text: sideways: your Sunder Armor applies from Cleave and Whirlwind, your Overpower benefits from your off-hand, Shield Slam may be used without a shield at reduced effect.

talents.name: Reckless
talents.text: subtraction: your critical strike chance is greatly increased; you cannot dodge, parry, or block.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. The Berserker Rage ability will generate N rage when used.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.text: reworked, as in Enhancement, from an attack speed percentage to what a critical strike triggers.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your attack power. In addition, the next 5 successful melee attacks will restore 10 health. This effect lasts 8 sec.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.text: Blocking generates rage; then refreshes Shield Block; then a block grants a stacking damage reduction; then blocked damage generates threat; then two blocks in a row reset Revenge.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.text: Reworked from defense skill into avoidance behaviour: a dodge or parry refreshes Revenge, then grants rage, then reduces Shield Slam's cooldown.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
talents.text: Bloodrage generates threat; it may be used while stunned.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.text: Reworked from armor into what taking a hit does: damage taken refreshes your active shout, then generates threat, then reduces the next hit.

talents.name: Iron Will
talents.text: Stun and charm duration is reduced; against immune sources it instead generates rage. Graded fallback per Section 5.8.

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum hit points for 20 seconds. After the effect expires, the hit points are lost.

talents.name: Improved Shield Block
talents.text: Shield Block covers an additional attack; then it may be used while stunned; then it refreshes on a parry.

talents.name: Improved Revenge
talents.text: Revenge stuns; against stun-immune targets it instead reduces their damage. Graded fallback per Section 5.8.

talents.name: Defiance
talents.text: Reworked from a threat percentage into threat behaviour: threat does not decay while you hold aggro, then transfers on taunt, then applies to everything in melee range.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor
talents.text: Sunder Armor costs less rage; then applies from Cleave; then does not fall off while you are in melee range.

talents.name: Improved Disarm
talents.text: Disarm lasts longer; against disarm-immune targets it instead reduces their damage. Graded fallback per Section 5.8.

talents.name: Improved Taunt
talents.text: Taunt's cooldown drops; taunt works on an already-taunted target.

talents.name: Concussion Blow
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Stuns the opponent for 5 sec.

talents.name: Sword and Board
talents.text: Cross-tree. Your Overpower may be used with a shield equipped; Deep Wounds applies from Shield Slam; Mortal Strike's healing reduction applies from Revenge.

talents.name: Bulwark
talents.text: Cross-tree. Your Cleave and Whirlwind generate block value; Bloodthirst heals for your block value.

talents.name: Unbreakable
talents.text: Subtraction. You cannot be critically struck. You can no longer critically strike.

talents.name: Shield Discipline
talents.text: Shield Slam refreshes Shield Block; then it dispels one magic effect; then it applies Sunder Armor; then it cannot miss; then it resets Last Stand below 20% health.

talents.name: Shield Slam
talents.text: Kept from vanilla. Slam the target with your shield, causing 225 to 236 damage, modified by your shield block value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Also causes a high amount of threat.
